scope: One offline kinematic requirement screen using all3800 saved selected raw observations from234/273, bothfeet;7600 solves. No simulation, optimizer, parameter search or runtime installation.
hypothesis: A coordinated six-joint correction with fixed pelvis and fixed sole centre may require sole rotation, additional joint authority or pitch-priority changes. Quantify these requirements before considering any new controller.
construction: J maps six leg velocities to sole-centre linear and foot angular velocity in gravity-aligned frame. Angular estimate=Rgyro+Jangular*qd. Solve J*delta=[0,0,0,-.025*omega_x,0,0];.025s is the existing273 scale, no sweep. Also evaluate full four-material-corner constraint rank and finite forward-kinematic changes.
constraints: All existing physical/material/quiet/command/feedback criteria unchanged. Required corrections are not authorized runtime controls; raw velocity unmodified, no torque/force truth or saved input fed to runtime.
